doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: Thelonious Monk and Blue Monk
summary: Reacting to Rowe's name, he recalls Thelonious Monk coming to hear him at the Trident and says Monk took 'Blue Monk' from McShann.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Right, okay. Well thanks so much on behalf of Hamilton College.
He was a big fan of mine, well we were fans of each other. And when I played and I used to play at the Trident, in Sausalito, he and his wife would come over. As a matter of fact
he’s invited me to his house, I’ve been to, when he was in the penthouse, I remember I walked in one night and he put on some old tunes. I said “Monk, is that you?” He says, “Boy, I’m a kid.”
He did such good things with the blues too you know.
He stole so much from Jay McShann. “Blue Monk,” that’s Jay McShann. [scats] That’s Jay McShann. I told him, he said, “Well, so?” You know.
